about: The table of the UI layering guard (#959): scripts/check-ui-layering.py holds ui/src to it, crates/barca-cli/src/ui_layering_tests.rs holds it to the CLI and the server. How to extend it: site/src/content/docs/contributing/ui-layering.md.

exempt.reason: auth: trades the one-use code `barca tokens bootstrap` prints for a token; a credential exchange, not a pipeline answer
auth: whether this server asks for a token, read before any credential exists
auth: token management is the browser's after bootstrap; a token is never printed twice, so there is nothing for a CLI to show beyond `barca tokens bootstrap`
connection probe: liveness, read-only mode and capabilities of this server, which every CLI command that takes --server reads for itself; no pipeline answer
page chrome: the project root (to shorten traceback paths) and the telemetry link; no pipeline answer
event stream: `barca get --server` and `barca logs --follow` follow the same stream; a stream has no JSON document to compare
no CLI command cancels a server run it is not attached to

api.does: typed request wrappers over the server's routes

apiBase.does: where the API is, from where the UI is served

credentials.does: the tab's credentials and the one fetch transport

eventStream.does: the run event stream: decoding, resume and reconnect

types.does: re-exports the generated wire types and the few shapes the server builds by hand

cacheStateDisplay.does: a cache state's word, tone, glyph and rank

healthDisplay.does: a health's word, tone, glyph and order; a tick outcome's word

dataSignals.does: the words of a node's data signals and of the coverage the server measured

glyph.does: the glyph of each state and tone

status.does: the run lifecycle's word, tone and glyph; kind and freshness labels

tone.does: the tones every display table maps onto

runs.does: a run's status, trigger and outcome as word, tone and glyph

graphState.does: a node's box on the graph: its served state, or the run on it, as a glyph and a word

causesView.does: the causes list's words over the rollup's roots

artifactSchema.does: an artifact's columns and sample rows as a table

documentTitle.does: the tab's title from the route

nodeDetail.does: the node panel's lines from the node's served row

pipeline.does: file names from node ids; a file's line from its sums in the rollup

queue.does: `GET /queue` as the queue strip's rows and labels

running.does: what a run in progress says of a node: elapsed, keys done, links

schedules.does: scheduled nodes as rows: next run, last run, the server's lateness in words

time.does: the one time format: relative, absolute, zones

health.does: a scope's rollup entry and its roots as the words of a bar, a label and a failures list

derives.what: `scopeAge`: a group row's "Last success" is the oldest of its members' times
derives.reason: the rollup has no times yet

derives.what: `consumersOf`, `downstreamIds`: the node panel's downstream count and what a pause with `--downstream` would cover
derives.reason: layout: a walk of the static graph (`inputs` of `GET /assets`, which `barca list --json` prints) for navigation; it reads no state and decides no health

assetTable.does: the flat assets table: rows from served rows, sort, file headers

derives.what: `compareAttention`: the default row order (failing, pinned, blocked, then cache state)
derives.reason: the table sorts by cache-state rank, not the server's health order

derives.what: `blockedKeys`: "N keys wait on X" read out of a state's `detail` text
derives.reason: the count is not served as a field

graph.does: assets as positioned graph nodes and edges

graphLayout.does: dagre layout per connected part and edge routes

graphLayout.worker.does: the layout, off the main thread

groups.does: the tree of groups, each listing the members the rollup counts under it; a group's box from its entry

lineage.does: the lineage drawn in place of a graph too big to read

partitionGrid.does: a node's key grid decoded, filtered, grouped and binned for the overview

derives.what: `heatmap`: a bin's colour is the worst state among the keys it holds
derives.reason: layout: many served key states drawn as one cell; no key's state is decided

rollupView.does: the rollup indexed by id and the geometry of the health map over it

derives.what: `behindAs`: the health the "not up to date" band of a node's keys is drawn as
derives.reason: key bands carry counts, not a health

assetFilters.does: the assets table's filters in the URL and the chips' counts

derives.what: `facetCounts`, `matchesStates`: which chip a row falls under, and how many rows each chip would show
derives.reason: the chips count the rows on screen under the other filters and a text search; their vocabulary is still the cache state

groupedPage.does: the grouped page: URL, scope, entries, search hits, order

knownStates.does: the last state loaded for each node, kept across navigation

palette.does: the command palette's index, search and program

pauses.does: what is paused, and the request a pause control sends

program.does: model, message, effect: how a page with state is written

runFeedback.does: a node's run status as the feedback a panel shows

runRecovery.does: what a page does when its run stream gaps or the server restarts

runStream.does: a run's events folded into the state a page renders

runTarget.does: what a toolbar's Run button acts on

runsPage.does: the Runs page's program, filters and the rows of a run's Steps

sidebar.does: the sidebar's collapse, width and the files and groups it lists

writeAccess.does: whether write controls are drawn: read-only, or not known yet

exemptions.reason: a Glyph name: the card of a node the server names a blocker for (`blockedBy`, from `root`) draws the blocked glyph
a Glyph name, as in DagNode
the key bar's word for keys that wait

shows "N keys blocked" read from a state's detail text
which chip a row falls under
`behindAs`: the health a node's key band is drawn as
the order of a health bar's segments: failures, then run work, then the rest in the served order; nothing is decided about a node
groups a node's keys by the state the server gave each key (the grid's own codes); no state is decided
